# BEFORE REPORTING:
If reporting a security vulnerability, please go [here](https://github.com/etangaming123/automaticlinkcleaner/security).

Check if the bot is online. This can be done with /ping. If the /ping command does not work, the bot is offline, and this bug should not be reported. 

If the command does work, you may report this bug.

# Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
## Example
✅Good:
Automatic Link Cleaner's /clean-link" command is stuck on infinite thinking when I input "https://example.com?sid=asdfafsdafdsfads
❌Bad:
alc is broken

Steps to reproduce the behavior.

## Example
✅Good:

2. Disable option "Enabled"
3. Send link
4. Still fixes the embed
❌Bad:
1. Use command
2. Command broken.
